kanto.flavorText: Appears in filthy areas. It thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

original-johto.flavorText: When two of these POKéMON's bodies are combined together, new poisons are created.

hoenn.flavorText: Born from polluted sludge in the sea, GRIMER’s favorite food is anything filthy. They feed on wastewater pumped out from factories.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon’s X-rays. It appears among filth.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon’s X-rays. It appears among filth.

updated-johto.flavorText: Wherever GRIMER has passed, so many germs are left behind that no plants will ever grow again.

original-unova.flavorText: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon’s X-rays. It appears among filth.

updated-unova.flavorText: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.

kalos.flavorText: Appears in filthy areas. It thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Grimer emerged from the sludge that settled on a polluted seabed. This Pokémon loves anything filthy. It constantly leaks a horribly germ-infested fluid from all over its body.

original-alola.flavorText: It was born from sludge transformed by exposure to X-rays from the moon. When its internal load of germs decreases, it dies.

updated-alola.flavorText: The wastewater coming from factories is clean these days, so Grimer have nothing to eat. They’re said to be on the verge of extinction.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won’t grow in its path.
